Questions to ask students:  
1. "Can you walk me through your last dinner purchase when studying on campus in the evening? What did you choose, and why?"  
2. "What other options did you consider for dinner that evening, and what made you choose or reject them?"

Discovery action: Interview five graduate students who study on campus in the evening. Focus on their actual recent dinner choices and alternatives, noting reasons for convenience, price, speed, and other factors. Record specific situations and decision-making details. This will help validate or challenge your assumption about delivery speed being the top priority.
